HELIOLISK - LICENSING AND CREDITS
Version 1.2.0 - 11 October 2026

================================================================================
1. HELIOLISK CODE
================================================================================

The Heliolisk theme (theme/heliolisk.zip) and the Heliolisk companion plugin
(plugins/heliolisk-core.zip) are original work, Copyright (c) 2026 Heliolisk,
released under the GNU General Public License v2 or later:
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html

This covers every PHP, CSS and JavaScript file written for the product (all of
theme/inc, theme/template-parts, theme/assets/css, theme/assets/js and
plugin/includes), the original SVG artwork (theme/assets/images/blog/arrow-dark.svg
and plugin widget icons hero-icon.svg), the translation template and the
documentation.

4. FONTS
================================================================================

Space Grotesk, Inter and Barlow Condensed are loaded from Google Fonts
(fonts.googleapis.com). All three are licensed under the SIL Open Font License
1.1: https://openfontlicense.org/ - the theme does not ship the font files.

================================================================================

The theme itself contains no photographs. Image files in the download:

  [AUTHOR TO COMPLETE BEFORE SUBMISSION] For every file in the last two groups
  above, state the source and license (for example "own photograph", or the

  their use. Envato requires every image in the preview and the demo content to

Documentation and preview images (documentation/assets/img, item preview

6. TRADEMARKS
================================================================================

No third-party logos or brand names are used as product content. Where the
documentation or screenshots mention WordPress, Elementor, Google Fonts or
Envato, those names belong to their owners and are used only to describe
compatibility.
